steps.note: Sort 0s, 1s and 2s in one pass. low tracks the end of the 0s, high the start of the 2s; mid scans the unknown middle.
arr[0] = 2 — swap it up to the 2s region (position 5); retreat high and re-check what landed at mid.
arr[0] = 0 — swap it down to the 0s region (position 0); advance both low and mid.
arr[1] = 0 — swap it down to the 0s region (position 1); advance both low and mid.
arr[2] = 2 — swap it up to the 2s region (position 4); retreat high and re-check what landed at mid.
arr[2] = 1 — already in the middle region; just advance mid.
arr[3] = 1 — already in the middle region; just advance mid.
Done in one pass — 4 swap(s). Every 0 then 1 then 2, sorted in place with no counting.
